title: Flatness and ordinary identity self braiding of an etale line
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and J an etale sheaf of A-modules on Y which is etale locally isomorphic to the tensor unit. Then J is flat and its ordinary self braiding is the identity. This is a subargument of [def-sfb-etale-coordinate-trace-data].

proof.text: The etale trivializing cover supplies isomorphisms to the tensor unit. The existing tensorInverseOfUpperStarIso constructs the internal-dual tensor inverse, so flat_of_tensorIso gives flatness.

proof.text: Upper-star functors of this cover preserve equalizers and jointly reflect isomorphisms, hence are jointly faithful on ordinary sheaf morphisms. Transport braiding through the monoidal adjunction, and use braiding naturality along the local unit isomorphisms. The self braiding of the unit is identity by unitor coherence. Cancel the invertible tensor comparisons and apply joint faithfulness.
